outline: This course provides the knowledge you need to understand the role of information systems in modern organizations, with particular focus on E-commerce and E-business. Along with skills learned in your functional area, knowledge from this course will help you effectively use information technology for solving business problems.

flexible_learning.content: Students will selected the required online courses on Coursera on 2026/12/29 (AI for Everyone) and 2027/1/4 (The AI, Climate, and Energy Connection) for self-learning purpose. Once the students finish all required modules, they can pay to obtain the certificate or just prove their learning hours by screenshot.
flexible_learning.outcome: Students can show screenshots to prove self-learning hours or the certificate on Coursera.
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio: Self-learning occupies extra 5% on top of final grade.
